question: Why is conceptual cognition not merely a transformation of the intellect?
premises: Transformation of the intellect is proposed as an explanation
Conceptual cognition is possible even beyond māyā
A merely intellectual transformation cannot account for that scope
inference: Conceptual cognition is not merely a transformation of the intellect because it is possible even beyond māyā.
plain_english: Nor is it a transformation of the intellect, because it is possible even beyond māyā.
